project_allegations_under_test.allegation: Whether any invoice, WIP, pro-forma, time narrative or debtor allocation was materially false, incomplete, duplicative or attributed to the wrong entity.
Whether the four Matkator promissory notes lawfully and accurately mapped to underlying work previously described in the Aweswell/LPB billing universe.
Whether Claim 1, Claim 2 and the WIP/unbilled pool can be reconciled without overlap or double satisfaction.
Whether any materially inaccurate or incomplete representation in Cambiario/ETJ was knowingly capable of inducing a prejudicial judicial disposition.
Whether the broader claim architecture could be transferred or used as economic leverage and whether any actual recipient/beneficiary connects to the Acosta Matos perimeter.
